usedFor: Apollo finds contacts and Pipedrive keeps the pipeline, so “When a new contact is created in Apollo” runs “Create Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new contact is created in Apollo” in Apollo, then “Create Lead” in Pipedrive
bestTemplate.why: Each contact Apollo adds lands in Pipedrive as a lead your reps can qualify.

watchOut: “When a new contact is created in Apollo” is polling, so leads appear after the next scheduled check.
